description: Returns the next Mercury cazimi (exact Sun–Mercury conjunction during a retrograde) after a date, with the UTC minute, the degree and 17′ window when known, and the previous cazimi. A cazimi within 12 hours of the date counts as today's and is returned as the previous one. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope. Paid tool: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.

from.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.

name: next_mercury_cazimi
title: Next Mercury cazimi
